surface: Chrome extension card and runtime toolbar tooltip with both channels installed
auth_mode: guest; extension identity is independent of account and organization

reproduction: Inspect both extension cards and toolbar tooltips: both currently say Matrx Extend.
Reload the development extension and reopen a panel from the toolbar.
The observed panel can belong to Store ID hnfolienncfklkgmdjjmhhegglimlamg while the operator intended the development ID.
expected: Keyed Chrome development card and default toolbar visibly say Matrx Extend DEV. Store card/default manifest title remain Matrx Extend, and its existing runtime assistance/clear tooltip strings (including Matrx at idle) remain unchanged. Testers can choose and verify the intended channel.
actual: WXT manifest callback emits Matrx Extend for both name and action.default_title on both Chrome channels; guest99 native copy test reopened the Store panel after development reload.
cause: Manifest name and action.default_title were unconditional literals even though the build callback distinguishes development from Store. Credential assistance independently overrides each tab's action title on worker boot and every status change. Its first repair used manifest.key as a runtime development signal, but the installed published Store manifest also has a key. Runtime channel now comes from the canonical extension ID registry.
sibling_census: Both Chrome manifest label fields and the runtime credential-assistance action title share the visible-identity failure and are repaired together. Firefox and Safari do not use the keyed Chrome development identity; Store identity, IDs, key, permissions, entrypoints, and existing status text remain unchanged.
